scope: Bounded independent read-only module/kernel provenance and exported-symbol audit; no build, guest operation or image change
status: Static prerequisites corroborated; normal-image module initialization and controller stability require owner runtime validation

kernel_and_builder.owner_extraction: Owner copied /out/Image, /kernel/.config, /kernel/vmlinux.symvers and generated utsrelease.h from a created container without running its ARM binaries; this independent audit reads the frozen local files

reconstruction_source.reviewed_method: Copy xhci host source/header inputs from the local builder's /kernel, replace the Renesas IS_ENABLED expression with0 in xhci-pci.c/h, set obj-m xhci-pci.o, copy vmlinux.symvers to Module.symvers, and run the kernel module build against that same /kernel
reconstruction_source.interpretation: The disabled Renesas path explains absence of its module dependency. The preserved module's exact historical build output was not reproduced during this audit.

independent_symbol_audit.method: Read actual module ELF symbol table with aarch64-linux-gnu-readelf -Ws; compare every GLOBAL UND symbol name with the symbol column of the extracted builder vmlinux.symvers
independent_symbol_audit.implication: All observed module global imports are exported by the matching builder kernel, with xHCI core built in. This supports bounded normal-image module-init validation; it is not a complete ABI or runtime stability proof.

historical_search_limit: Research notes around GHIDRA-FINDINGS.md1033 record rebuilding this emulator-only controller module and subsequent successful hub discovery, and earlier QEMU arguments use qemu-xhci. The bounded audit did not locate a historical successful-load log pinned to both exact module87f16 and Imagec66e4 hashes. No exact historical runtime pass is claimed.
next_bounded_validation: Owner builds the normal offline emulator image and verifies module initialization, xHCI controller/hub enumeration and absence of unknown-symbol/vermagic errors before functional tests. This audit does not operate that image or change the supported mod candidate.
limits: Emulator6.6 controller fixture only; no physical AZ/kernel4.4 compatibility, new-image recovery, stable hub runtime, five-source visibility or candidate acceptance is inferred.
